stemMd:
The collection of notebooks, together with several loose letters, ______ a detailed record of the expedition. Researchers have used the materials to compare the travelers' observations with later surveys.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The grammatical subject is collection, not notebooks or letters. The intervening phrase does not change its number, so the singular verb provides is required.

distractorRationale.d: The plural auxiliary does not agree with collection.
distractorRationale.c: Were is plural and conflicts with the singular subject.
distractorRationale.b: The head of the subject is singular collection.
